lines.zh: 我跟在主体的后面，慢半拍。
lines.en: I trail the main body, half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 我只是一部分，飞得不太稳。
lines.en: I'm only a part, and I fly unsteadily.
Black mist drags at my edges.
I follow the route the main body takes.

lines.zh: 我少了一小块，也不碍事。
lines.en: A piece of me is missing, and it doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，和它保持距离。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, a distance from it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀只有半边清楚。
lines.en: Only half of my wing is clearly there.

lines.zh: 我从梁的一头漂到另一头。
lines.en: I drift from one end of the beam to the other.
I have no body of my own.
I pause and let it move ahead.
I follow the tail of that mist.

lines.zh: 我们合起来才像一只蝙蝠。
lines.en: Together we make something like a bat.
I hang at the corner of the shadow.
I wait for the main body to call me.
My shape slowly spreads.
Without it, I can't go far.
I count how many pieces I'm missing.

lines.zh: 我想不起原来长什么样。
lines.en: I can't remember how I used to look.
I cling to the wall seam, still missing a piece.
It's cold, and I have no skin.
I hear the main body's wings.
I leave a mark on the wall.
Black mist rises off me.

lines.zh: 我试着抓住自己的影子。
lines.en: I try to catch my own shadow.

lines.zh: 这一块和那一块对不上。
lines.en: This piece doesn't fit that one.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我在慢慢明白。
lines.en: In the quiet I slowly understand.

lines.zh: 你看见的是我的一部分。
lines.en: What you see is only a part of me.
I move along your side.
You can't find the main body, can you?
I'm at the edge of your sight.
You turn your head, and I shift a little.
You reach out, and I scatter.
Only half of my face is there.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，不眨眼，也不散开。
lines.en: I stare without blinking, and I will not scatter.
There's another piece of me behind you.
Don't count them; you won't finish.
Raising the lamp won't help.
I cling to a corner of your shadow.
The main body leads; I keep half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我不说话，因为我说不出。
lines.en: I don't speak, because I can't.
You carry light, and I dislike it.
Come closer, and you should turn around.
I can see your back.
This piece of me stays here.
Half of me scatters and comes back.
That knocked me crooked.
A layer of mist is gone.
I cling to the wall, shaken.
I've lost an edge.
I shrink to a small knot.
It hurts, though I have no nerves.
I shrink into the dark.
I won't remember this.
I pull back what scattered.
I lean toward that smell of blood.
What the main body wants, I smell first.
That's not enough to split between two.
I circle it, not daring to touch.
I extend a thread of mist toward it.
Don't give it to me; give it to the main body.
I can't taste anything.
That sweetness makes me uneasy.
I'm hungrier than the main body.
One step closer and I'll come apart.
You hit half of me.
I pass through you.
My edge has been flattened.
Don't touch; I haven't grown back.
We collided and our mist mixed.

lines.zh: 散开的影子，又聚在一起。
lines.en: The scattered shade pulls itself together.
You pushed back too hard.

lines.zh: 这一块贴到你衣服上了。
lines.en: A piece of me stuck to your clothes.
I can't shake off that smell.
Bump me again and I'll scatter.

lines.zh: 主体在做什么，我就跟着。
lines.en: Whatever the main body does, I follow.
We were one to begin with.
Two shadows lie on top of each other.
I don't find a partner on my own.
That sort of thing isn't for me.

lines.zh: 我只是那团雾的另一半。
lines.en: I'm only the other half of that mist.
I cling to it and wait for it to move.
The black mist splits into two again.
I can't tell myself from it.
Neither of us can leave the other.

lines.zh: 我用一缕雾把它卷起来。
lines.en: I curl a thread of mist around it.
It slipped through once.
I push it toward the main body.
I hold it up, and it's hard work.

lines.zh: 它从我指缝里穿过去了。
lines.en: It passes through my fingers.
I press it into the shadow.
I can't carry it far.
I hold it, and half is inside my mouth.
This thing is heavier than I am.
I let go, and it hits the floor.

lines.zh: 主体锁住了谁，我也锁住。
lines.en: Whoever the main body locks onto, I lock onto too.
I come around from the other side.
I've set foot on your shadow.
We can only bite together.
I slide across the floor toward you.
Your back is open.
I'm here, blocking the retreat.
I watch you, and it watches you.
This piece is closer than the main body.
Don't assume there's only one.
I am only one piece of the bat.
We're about to join.

lines.zh: 你听到的翅膀声有两重。
lines.en: The wingbeats you hear come in pairs.
You count as a piece of prey too.
I've got the position.
That bite wasn't mine.
I circle to your left.

lines.zh: 我一半在你灯外，一半在里
lines.en: Half of me is outside your lamp, half within.
Look up, and I drop.

lines.zh: 我一半在这儿，一半在那边。
lines.en: Half of me is here, half over there.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到我这一块。
lines.en: Your lamp can't reach this piece.
I wait for the main body to move first.

lines.zh: 我是那对翅膀的一部分。
lines.en: I am one part of that pair of wings.
The mist is getting thicker.
When your fingers twitch, I veer aside.
I breathe at your ear.

lines.zh: 暗影蝙蝠的一块，跟着飞。
lines.en: A piece of the Shade Bat, flying along.
Watch your feet.
That shadow is moving.
It's coming from above.
One inch closer.
I've wound myself around your shadow.
The two of us close the net.
Almost — don't look back.
I bite the back of your neck, lightly.
A thread of mist slips into your sleeve.
I sweep past your cheek.
The cold stabs you once.
I scatter, and your blow finds nothing.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只划到一道浅痕。
lines.en: My claws leave only a shallow line.
The main body's bite is heavier.

lines.zh: 散开的影子，又聚回来了。
lines.en: The scattered shade gathers again.
You knocked a corner off me.
That one was my share.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手腕，不肯松。
lines.en: I clamp your wrist and won't let go.

lines.zh: 雾扑在你脸上，你什么也看不见。
lines.en: Mist hits your face and you see nothing.
I strike at your knee.

lines.zh: 两只一起咬，你顾不过来。
lines.en: Two of us bite, and you can't cover both.

lines.zh: 我的爪子挂在你衣角上。
lines.en: My claws snag your hem.
I put my upper half into that one.
I separate from the main body.
The mist on the altar scatters and gathers.
Only one of my wings is clearly there.
I land on the beam and wobble.
The dark corners of this room are mine.
I circle that patch of darkness.
I've been pulled out and I'm not steady.

lines.zh: 我只是影蝠掉下来的一角。
lines.en: I am only a corner shed by the Shade Bat.

lines.zh: 我试着张开，只能张开一半。
lines.en: I try to spread, and only half opens.
Without it, I'd come apart.

lines.zh: 我把墙上的影子吃掉一点。
lines.en: I eat a little of the shadow on the wall.
I wait for the main body to fly first.
The air has cooled half a degree.
I flatten against the ceiling.

lines.zh: 雾里传来我自己的振翅
lines.en: My own wingbeat comes back through the mist.
The piece I'm missing is still elsewhere.
I'm slowly putting myself together.
This place belongs to us.
Fire burns a hole through my mist.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，撞在石砖上散了。
lines.en: I fall and scatter on the tiles.

lines.zh: 水混进雾里，我沉得抬不起。
lines.en: Water mixes into my mist and I sink.
The blast blows all of me apart.
An arrow passes through, leaving a gap.
That light presses me flat.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我薄得快要看不见。
lines.en: Starved too long, I'm nearly invisible.
A white flash, and I nearly vanished.

lines.zh: 影子断了，我不知道该贴哪儿。
lines.en: The shadow ended, and I don't know where to cling.
